<b>Runt</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They appear in [[Act 3]] and give the <i>[[Runtfeast]]</i> [[wish]] if the <i>[[Broodfeast]]</i> wish was not completed by then.

== Background == 
Runt is one of the newborns from the recently hatched brood of the [[Huntress]], so named due to them being smaller and weaker than the rest of their siblings.<ref name = siblings>Runt: <i>"Me'sss born not like siblingsss, themsss large and hard... All themsss did feasted and flew."</i></ref> If <i>Broodfeast</i> was not completed before Act 3, Huntress gets eaten by her brood,<ref>Hornet dialogue with Runt: <i>"I see it clear, child. The tall mother's meat has fed the brood fresh hatched."</i></ref> who feasted on her flesh and flew away.<ref name = siblings></ref> Runt was left behind, hoping to grow strong and large like their siblings did.<ref>Runt: <i>"Usss's wantss grow sssstrong... much... Be like siblingsss, sharp, hard..."</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
Upon entering the den Runt can be found hanging from the roof, but soon drops down to talk with Hornet. They lament about being left behind by their siblings and not having feasted like the rest of them.<br>
They ask Hornet to provide them with meat to feed upon in order to grow large and strong like their siblings. This starts the <i>Runtfeast</i> wish. Upon completing the wish, Runt thanks Hornet and provides her with the [[Longclaw]] tool.

==Location==
Runt can be found in a hut in the southwestern part of the [[Putrified Ducts]] during [[Act 3]] if the <i>[[Broodfeast]]</i> [[wish]] was not completed by then.
